column2: Mental Demand: How mentally demanding was the task?
column3: Physical Demand: How physically demanding was the task?
column4: Temporal Demand: How hurried or rushed was the pace of the task?
column5: Performance: How succesful were you in accomplishing what you were asked to do?
column6: Effort: How hard did you have to work to accomplish your level of performance?
column7: Frustration: How insecure, discouraged, irritated, stressed and annoyed were you?
